# add jetbrains toolbox

Add the `jetbrains-toolbox` cask — the JetBrains Toolbox App, which installs and updates the JetBrains IDEs (GoLand, PhpStorm, …) — to the Homebrew toolset, so the IDEs themselves are not declared one by one. The original reference is the [cask page](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/jetbrains-toolbox).
